The Texas Workforce Commission (TWC) is seeking applications for the Texas Senior Community Service Employment Program (SCSEP). SCSEP is a community service and work-based training program that provides skills training for low-income, unemployed seniors aged fifty-five (55) years and older. value.description_html:
The Texas Department of Public Safety (DPS) requires the procurement of enterprise licenses for an AI-powered process documentation and playbook automation platform (Scribe by Colony Labs, Inc. part numbers NPN-COLON-HUBMA, NPN-COLN-VIEW, NPN-COLN-CREAT-A, and NPN-COLON-CREAT-B, or an equivalent product meeting the minimum functional specification describing herein.).

The platform enables authorized personnel to rapidly capture desktop or browser-based  standard operating procedures through screen recording, automatically generate editable step-by-step guides and playbooks with screenshots and annotations, organize content into governed teams/hubs with granular access controls, and distributed interactive documentation for training, standard operating procedures (SOPs), knowledge management, and operational efficiency across the agency.

The Procurement includes exactly one (1) Hub Management Module, fifty (50) Creator License (10 at the first-tier pricing level and 40 at the second-tier pricing level), an two thousand five hundred (2,500) Viewer Licenses for one (1) year term from the date of license activation or as otherwise specified in the resulting contract.  All licenses shall include standard maintenance, software updates, and technical support through the term.

provider.summary: Official provider example; checked against AIsa request constraints

agency_number.description: Texas agency / SmartBuy member number, e.g. 529 (see list_agencies; the suffix of agency_name). Pattern: ^[A-Za-z0-9]+$.

include_presolicitations.description: Solicitation list only: also include pre-solicitation notices (the site's includePreSolicitation flag).

keyword.description: Free-text keyword. Bare keyword searches over the whole ESBD can take a minute upstream; combine with status, agency_number or dates when possible.

nigp_code.description: NIGP class (3 digits) or class-item (5 digits) code, e.g. 925 or 92500 (see list_nigp_codes). Pattern: ^[0-9]{3}([0-9]{2})?$.

notice_type.description:
Which ESBD list to search: solicitations (default) or pre-solicitation notices.

Provider reference: allowed values ["solicitation", "presolicitation"]; default "solicitation".

page.description:
1-based page; 24 rows per page (fixed by the site). Use next_page from the previous call.

Provider reference: minimum 1; maximum 10000; default 1.

posted_from.description: Posting-date lower bound, YYYY-MM-DD (Texas local). Requires posted_to. Pattern: ^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$.

posted_to.description: Posting-date upper bound, YYYY-MM-DD (Texas local). Requires posted_from. Pattern: ^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$.

solicitation_id.description: Exact public solicitation id, e.g. HHS0017399v3.

status.description: Site status code: 1 Posted, 2 Awarded, 3 Posting Cancelled, 5 Closed, 6 Addendum Posted, 10 Expired (pre-solicitations), 11 No Award. Pattern: ^[0-9]{1,2}$.
